guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the wanted utilisation, the overtime rule, the employer extra, the late rent limit, the wanted pay share and the retail target.
Check Team, Services and Resources. They hold the owner, the technicians, the front desk, the outside contacts, the 20 services and the four chairs and the treatment room.
Use Pay Runs every month: type the takings, tips, hours and the booth rent. Total cost to the studio, days late and the pay check fill in by themselves.
Keep Commission Statements and Hourly Timesheets for the technician on commission and the hourly team. Overtime and gross pay follow the rule in Start.
Record every booth rent in Booth Rent Ledger: a booth renter is a technician who rents a chair and keeps their own takings. Late rent shows as arrears and goes to Rent Chase Log.
Use Tips Ledger to pass on card tips after the card fee and to see what is still owed to each technician.
Fill Technician Months and Technician Days. Utilisation (the share of bookable minutes that are sold), revenue per booked hour and the overload flag calculate themselves.
Set the wanted figures for each technician in Productivity Targets, then read Service Mix, Reviews and Retail by Technician to see who needs help and what to coach.
Plan Schedules and Time Off, record Training Log courses and write each Check-in with the next step and the review date.

Use the 14 calculators to test a commission, overtime, rent income, a late rent step, a pay model and a new technician. Employment and tax rules stay generic: check your own local rules or an adviser.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in. Read the Technician Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Technician Pay and Productivity Excel Template for Lash, Brow, Nail and Skin Care Studios: Commission, Booth Rent, Utilisation
listing.headline: Pay your technicians fairly, collect booth rent and see who is productive
listing.description:
Run the people in the chairs of a small lash, brow, nail and skin care studio with one Excel workbook for the owner and the front desk. Built for 3 to 5 technicians, employees on commission or by the hour and booth renters (technicians who rent a chair and keep their own takings), plus a front-desk coordinator. Pay Runs shows commission, hourly pay, tips, booth rent and the total cost of the team each month, with the pay still unpaid. Commission Statements, Hourly Timesheets with overtime, Tips Ledger and Booth Rent Ledger with arrears and a Rent Chase Log keep every payment and every late rent in view.

Technician Months and Technician Days work out utilisation, the share of bookable minutes that are sold, revenue per booked hour, rebooking rate and an overload flag for a day with too many appointments, set against a target for each technician. Service Mix, Reviews, Retail by Technician, Schedules, Time Off, Training Log and Check-ins show who is productive and who needs coaching.

14 calculators cover commission, overtime, rent income, a late rent step, a pay model comparison, a technician profit contribution, utilisation, a target gap, tips, a renter value check, a scorecard, a new technician break-even, a schedule check and a commission grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 polite ready text messages to technicians, renters, the front desk, the owner and the accountant.

This is part six of the Beauty Studio suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you run your studio and does not give legal, employment, tax or health advice: check your own local rules or ask an adviser.

de.Check Team, Services and Resources. They: Überprüfen Sie Team, Dienste und Ressourcen. Sie umfassen den Eigentümer, die Techniker, die Rezeption, die Außenkontakte, die 20 Servicekräfte sowie die vier Stühle und den Behandlungsraum.
de.Use Pay Runs every month: type the takin: Verwenden Sie jeden Monat Lohnläufe: Geben Sie die Einnahmen, Trinkgelder, Stunden und die Standmiete ein. Gesamtkosten für das Studio, Verspätungstage und der Gehaltsscheck werden selbst ausgefüllt.

de.Use Tips Ledger to pass on card tips aft: Verwenden Sie Trinkgeldbuch, um nach der Kartengebühr Trinkgelder weiterzugeben und zu sehen, was jedem Techniker noch geschuldet wird.

de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, befolgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Text mit den bereits geschriebenen Details zu senden. Lesen Sie jede Woche die Techniker-Dashboard und Diagramme.

de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

pt.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edite o texto aqui; o conteúdo entre {chaves} é preenchido com os dados de cada linha. Os links estão nas tabelas.
pt.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Escolha um registro: cada etapa recebe uma data prevista. Faça uma cópia desta planilha para cada registro.
pt.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos atualizados com os dados das planilhas. Escolha nas células amarelas para atualizar gráficos e indicadores.
